Privacy notice

Staging policy preview. Live online purchases are closed.

The Cosmic Energizers operates POSH Inquiry Navigator from P-72, Sector 46, Gurugram, Haryana, India. The Privacy Contact is Ankur Agrawal. For privacy requests or concerns, email ankur.attorneyatlaw@gmail.com or call +91 79021 71932.

Information we process

  • Accounts and access We process account contact details, authentication and session information, product access, seat assignments and administrative access changes to operate and secure the service.
  • Orders and billing We process the product, amount, order and payment references, status, access dates and billing details needed for fulfilment and accounting. Checklist orders include the organisation name used to show the licence holder. Online checklist ticks are stored in your browser and stay on that browser. Razorpay processes the payment fields in its checkout. Navigator receives the information needed to verify payment and fulfil the order.
  • Enquiries and support We use the contact and organisation details, selected enquiry information and support correspondence you provide to respond, investigate issues and record their resolution.
  • Community and analytics Where the community is available, submissions and reports are stored for moderation. Approved posts may be public under an alias. Where optional analytics are enabled, we collect marketing-page and campaign events after you opt in. You can change your choice through Analytics choices.

In staging, individual guide test access is held temporarily and may reset after a restart. Staging plan and checklist orders retain the account, order and payment references needed to verify test access or delivery. Read Razorpay’s privacy policy.

Inquiry records and local files

The guided workflow processes procedural selections, dates, codes and draft preparation in your browser. Navigator does not provide a case-upload or shared case-storage service. Use reference codes and keep identities, testimony, evidence and official records in your institution’s authorised system. Keep confidential case material out of community posts, enquiries and support requests.

Recovery files and downloaded drafts stay in the location you choose. Recovery files are readable JSON. Store them securely, verify a saved copy before closing the workflow, and control who can access it.

The file-fingerprint tool reads selected files locally to calculate SHA-256 values. Save a recovery file before closing or reloading the guide. Navigator reads recovery files locally and asks for confirmation before replacing the current session. Recovery files exclude downloaded Word files and selected evidence files.

Providers and retention

We use hosting, authentication, email and payment providers for their respective functions. The service uses essential browser storage for sign-in and sessions. Hosting and security systems may process network and operational information.

Sign-in uses an encrypted HttpOnly session cookie. The optional marketing analytics choice is stored in your browser. Account requests do not include your inquiry selections.

We retain account and access information for service and account support, transaction and billing records for accounting and legal obligations, and security and support records to investigate and resolve issues. Plan expiry and the end of a download window do not automatically erase account or order records.

Privacy requests

Contact the Privacy Contact to request access, correction or deletion, withdraw optional consent, or raise a grievance, as applicable. We may verify your identity. Legal, accounting and security obligations may require retention of certain records.

Staging checkout reminders

Starting a signed-in test checkout records the selected item and checkout status for up to 30 days. The separate reminder option uses your verified account email to send at most two messages. Use the stop link in a reminder or the checkout controls to withdraw. Real payments are disabled on staging.
